literal: The goodness of companionship prosperity will give; the goodness of action desired all things will give.
translation: The goodness of one's companions brings prosperity, but the goodness of one's own actions will yield everything that is desired.
modern: நல்ல துணையின் நன்மை செல்வத்தைத் தரும்; செய்யும் செயலின் நன்மையோ விரும்பிய எல்லாவற்றையும் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the benefits of external support with the power of personal action. While having good associates and helpers (துணைநலம்) brings wealth and growth (ஆக்கம்), it is the purity and excellence of one's own actions (வினைநலம்) that delivers every single desired goal (வேண்டிய எல்லாம்). The poetic lengthening in 'தரூஉம்' emphasizes the steady flow of wealth from good company, but the poet shows that pure action is far superior because its rewards are limitless. Ultimately, personal integrity in what we do is the ultimate key to fulfilling all our aspirations.
